programmes.d: Investigators follow the trail of a seemingly untraceable late-night call as they search for the killer of businesswoman Peggy Nadell.
When a woman's remains are found miles from her home, investigators start digging into her past.
Keith Morrison reports on a dramatic undercover operation in Palm Beach, Florida to save a wife and mother who had no idea she was in danger.
Years after a woman is murdered in the back of her comic book store, new evidence is discovered that sends the investigation in a surprising direction.
When a determined investigator works with a prosecutor in hope of solving a 20-year-old murder case, a dark secret is uncovered.
The unbelievable murder of Carol Kennedy, a popular college professor, artist and mother.
After a woman reports a prowler, police find her Olympic bronze medalist husband dead in their backyard.
Authorities charge an Oklahoma doctor for his wife's death.
Months after a woman and her husband come down with the same mysterious illness, the woman dies after experiencing the same symptoms; old recordings reveal the twisted truth about her demise.
When a woman is found murdered in her bed, her husband and her son accuse each other of being the killer.
A chance encounter on the Pacific Coast Highway with a woman he first spoke to in a jail cell leads Keith Morrison to reexamine the mysterious death of Las Vegas casino magnate Ted Binion.
A bombshell more than a decade after the crime reignites the investigation into the death of Sarah Pagel's mother, who was killed when Sarah was seven.
A Connecticut bank executive is targeted by criminals who force him to rob his own bank.

A beloved Staten Island teacher is found dead in the home she shared with her husband; an unknown number in her cell phone leads investigators to reveal troubles in her seemingly idyllic life -- and to ultimately unearth her killer.
When a luxury car dealer is found dead, detectives suspect one of his lovers, but lack of evidence stalls the case for a year until one clue breaks it wide open.
Detectives suspect an inside job when a coin collector and his wife are found dead in their home with no sign of forced entry or evidence of theft.
A successful businesswoman falls for a banker who may not be who he seems.

The missing-persons case of 12-year-old Jonelle Matthews in Colorado remained a mystery for more than three decades until detectives narrowed in on a suspect whose bizarre behavior after her disappearance hinted at something much more sinister.
When a pediatric dentist is found dead, police uncover a complex plot and their suspect leads investigators on an international manhunt; the lead detective speaks out for the first time.

The disappearance of 19-year-old Alaska Native Sonya Ivanoff sends shockwaves through the small coastal city of Nome, Alaska; police scramble to find answers until a note is found in a stolen police vehicle telling the cops to back off or else.

When a young pregnant mother goes missing in Virginia, her family embarks on a frantic search, but the case eventually goes cold; years later, investigators speak with a woman who tells a harrowing story and may hold the key to solving the case.

When high school student Megan Nichols vanishes from her Illinois home, her mother finds a note saying that she ran away; a grisly discovery made three years later changes the course of the investigation.
